critique: Iteration 2's biggest remaining gaps were jargon (DVN/Sherlock/validity/ITGC/SoD/4-eyes left unglossed inline — a salesperson could not re-explain SL07 or SL12 to a customer) and uneven desire-lift on Act-2 evidence slides (SL10/SL11/SL13 informed but did not pull the audience forward). SL07 used a bare 「¥27」 as its action statement, requiring the audience to do the interpretive work; SL09's most desire-lifting fact — '47% ≈ $4.5B が同設定で稼働' — was rendered as small grey center text easy to miss on a 60-second skim. SL11 had no benefit-framed H1 at all, leaving the most important conceptual re-definition of the deck without a sentence a salesperson would actually say aloud.
changelog: SL02: added inline credentials anchor ('自律監査エージェント SPECA／ICLR 2026 安全性ワークショップ採択') below the role line to restore the credibility the dashed-placeholder removal had thinned, without re-introducing a draft box.
SL03: glossed '監査・バグバウンティ' on first use ('第三者によるコード監査(事前点検) ＋ バグバウンティ(発見者への報奨金) — 防衛は実質この二本だけ') so a non-domain salesperson can follow the two-pillar setup.

SL07: restructured the ¥27 fact slide — moved the report-context line above the headline, glossed Sherlock as '主要バウンティ・プラットフォームSherlockの規定' and 'validity率' as '(報告のうち実在脆弱性と認定された割合)' inline, and added a benefit-framed closing action line 「— もう一本の柱(バグバウンティ)も、研究者を守れる経済になっていない」 so the takeaway is explicit, not implied.

SL09: promoted the CoinGecko '47% ≈ $4.5B が同設定で稼働' fact from small grey center text to a bordered, text-2xl, bold pull-quote with the label 'CoinGecko 事後調査' — the single most desire-lifting fact in Act 2 now catches the 60-second skim.

SL10: rewrote the close-out caption from '業界の防衛モデルには、初めから穴がある' to '穴の名前は『運用・統制・経済』 — 皆様が20年磨いてきた領域' so the slide pivots from diagnosis to a forward-looking benefit framing the audience can hear themselves in.

SL11: added a benefit-framed action title at the top ('脆弱性とは『コードのバグ』ではなく、経済の不等式である') and a closing one-liner ('守るべきは『欠陥』ではなく『経路』 — チェックリスト型監査では原理的に届かない') so the inequality formula now sits between a salesperson-deliverable claim and its operational consequence.
SL12: glossed DVN inline as 'DVN = Decentralized Verifier Node。検証者ノード1名だけで承認が通る LayerZero 構成' so a non-domain viewer no longer needs prior knowledge to follow the 1-of-1 DVN = 副署なき特権ID equivalence.

SL13: glossed ITGC/SoD/4-eyes inline in the subtitle ('J-SOX ITGC(IT全般統制) ／ SoD(職務分離) ／ 4-eyes(複眼承認)') and added the explicit desire-lift line '→ 皆様の20年は、そのまま世界の防衛資産になる' below the table — converting the mapping from a correct observation into a destiny statement the audience wants.
remaining_gaps: Re-render and verify SL07 and SL11 do not overflow vertically after the added action-title and closing benefit lines — the `fact` layout on SL07 centers content and adding the top caption + bottom closer may push out the lowest line. If overflow appears, drop the top caption on SL07 (the H1 ¥27 + bottom closer alone carry the message).

SL05 (5-row incident table) still reads as a flat enumeration; the close-out caption '共通点:いずれも『監査の網』の内側' informs but does not lift desire. Consider promoting it to a bordered pull-quote (same treatment as SL09) so the skim test catches the systemic claim, not just the rows.

SL06 (founder quote slide) renders the quote across 3 lines at very large type — visually striking, but the slide carries no benefit-framed caller that ties it back to the audience's day job ('業界で最も慎重なチーム = 皆様の現場で言えば...'). Add a one-line bridge caption under the attribution.

SL04 ('約3,000億円') and SL08 ('This is a deployment configuration issue, not a security vulnerability') are still pure facts/quotes without an explicit benefit framing for the listener. A one-line caption tying each to 'なぜ皆様の領域か' would lift desire by ~0.2 on each without compromising the punch.

SL01 hook 「監査が引いた線を、損失が越えた」 is strong, but the close on SL17 only echoes 'その線' verbally — consider an explicit visual callback (e.g. the same horizontal line motif under '線は越えられた') to satisfy hook↔close emotional payoff.
